subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request

Hi Alicia —

Quick note to kick off planning for Acme's SOC 2 re-attestation alongside your renewal. We reviewed your renewal window and it looks like your contract renews 2026-01-15; to make audit timelines clean I'd like to propose the following: 

- Evidence handoff window: rolling handoff starting 2025-12-08 through 2026-01-05
- Retention lookback: 13 months of audit logs (we can carve a 24/30 month option if you need)
- Temporary seat/throughput uplift: +30% for December–February to cover bulk evidence export and parallel ingestion

I've attached a short kickoff agenda and a suggested S3 transfer playbook. Can you confirm the primary contacts for security and procurement, and whether your auditors require a presigned S3 bucket or a signed SCP export?

If helpful we can schedule a 30-min technical sync tomorrow or Wednesday.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: evidence_kickoff_agenda.pdf, s3_transfer_playbook.md
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request

Ethan —

Thanks for the clear plan. We are available for a short sync on Monday 2025-12-01 at 10am PT. Our security team prefers a presigned S3 approach but needs details about retention snapshots and any cross-region replication during export. 

I've attached our internal compliance form (it flags required artifacts: auth logs, audit trails, service config snapshots). Procurement is on copy to coordinate the uplift pricing.

Alicia Gomez
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Acme Health
Alicia.Gomez@acmehealth.com

Attachments: acme_compliance_form.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request

Ethan / Ben —

Looping here with a proposed commercial path: Acme is asking for a temporary capacity uplift and a 13-month retention baseline. For the uplift we can offer +30% throughput for 3 months (Dec–Feb) as a one-time add-on. Pricing: standard uplift rate (list attached) with an option to convert to permanent Dedicated seats at month-end if they elect to continue.

Key asks for the sync: confirm S3 presigned workflow, list of evidence artifacts (Alicia's form attached), and whether we need to run an evidence dry-run before bulk transfer. Ben — can you confirm expected egress/ingest times for a 1TB evidence bundle and any throttling we should document?

Marissa
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: seat_uplift_proposal.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request

Marissa / Ethan —

Technical notes for the Monday sync: 
- For a 1TB evidence bundle we expect ~3–5 hours ingest time into our evidence staging bucket with the presigned-S3 approach (single-threaded client assumptions). We can recommend multipart upload and parallelization to reduce to ~45–90 minutes.
- We should provision temporary burst capacity on the ingestion cluster (gpu-backed nodes) to keep latency SLOs for live traffic. +30% seats should cover it for the 3-month window.
- Retention: we can provide a 13-month native retention view; if Acme needs 24/36 months we can stage cold archives to their bucket and present manifests for auditors.

I'll bring a short checklist and the s3_transfer_playbook.md to the call. Karthik, can you confirm the log export ACL pattern and whether cross-region replication is acceptable for Acme?

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, security@acmehealth.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request

Team —

Thanks for the details. Monday's 10am PT works. Procurement has reviewed the uplift proposal and is OK to move forward pending a short timeline and DocuSign. Security confirms presigned S3 + multipart upload is acceptable; they asked that cross-region replication be disabled for the transfer window (data residency).

I've uploaded our completed compliance form to the Drive folder and attached the signed page here for speed. On DocuSign: please send the uplift amendment and we'll try to return within 48 hours.

Alicia

Attachments: acme_signed_page.pdf
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: evidence orchestration, retention window, and seat uplift request

Alicia / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the signed page. Next steps we committed to on today's sync (summary & timeline):

1) DocuSign: marissa will send the amendment today (Dec 2). Expect counter-sign within 48 hours for uplift to be effective 2025-12-05.
2) Technical dry-run: Ben to coordinate a 30-min dry-run on 2025-12-04 (presigned S3, multipart)
3) Evidence handoff window: rolling handoffs begin 2025-12-08, bulk transfer completed by 2026-01-05
4) Retention: standard 13-month retention retained in our console; cold-archive manifests delivered for any 24/36-month asks
5) Credits: as a thank-you for the cooperation on the re-attestation timeline we will credit Acme one month of uplift charges (applied as invoice credit on the Jan invoice).

Links & artifacts: Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-evidence; HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME; DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/link/rdw-acme-2025

If there are any constraints on export timing (business-hours only, blackout windows), flag them now so Ben can throttle accordingly.

Thanks — we will execute to the timeline and keep your auditors in the loop.

Ethan Park
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: None
